question: Should `OPENCLAW_CHECK_WORKFLOWS_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS` become a supported operator-facing environment override, or should the timeout remain an internal fixed default with an in-process test seam?
rationale: The repository policy treats new environment surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and requires proof that existing defaults or product behavior cannot meet the need.

options.title: Keep timeout internal
options.body: Remove the environment override and inject a short timeout only through the testable command runner while retaining the fixed production timeout.

options.title: Approve the override
options.body: Keep the environment variable only with explicit owner approval, documented behavior, bounds, and support expectations.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Defer this change if neither a fixed default nor a supported override contract is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Keep timeout internal
recommendation.body: Remove the environment override and inject a short timeout only through the testable command runner while retaining the fixed production timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level configuration-surface decision rather than a mechanical termination fix.
